scope: Fresh review of photo recovery and reader entry rotation across cover, collection, navigation, hidden routes and disposal
test_changes: Added test/review/photo_recovery_rereview_test.dart with six independent lifecycle and recovery cases
Transport confirmation uses the installed CacheManager and HttpFileService with an in-memory repository/filesystem and a MockClient; no real backend request is made

findings.title: Explicit retry cannot revisit a repaired preview after every candidate failed
findings.cause: The explicit branch renews or resolves only _sources[_index]. The index is already at the final original, and explicit retry never starts a new bounded traversal of the other sources.
findings.trigger: Preview and original both fail temporarily; the preview becomes available while the view remains mounted, but the original is still unavailable. The user taps the photo retry action.

proof.test: review: explicit retry must reconsider a repaired preview after all sources failed

findings.recommendation: Have explicit retry start a fresh finite candidate pass, clearing or updating the relevant failure markers. Keep one automatic URL renewal per storage source in that pass and retain stale-result/disposal guards.

findings.title: An already-running reader preparation keeps starting fallback and later photo batches while hidden
findings.cause: The rasterizer checks TickerMode before entering preparePage, but the asynchronous LayerBuilder/SnapfitImage loops only check context.mounted. A covered route remains mounted. After one pending download finishes or fails, its original fallback and the next batch can begin even though TickerMode is disabled.

proof.test: review: hiding an in-flight reader must pause fallback and later photo batches

findings.recommendation: Thread an activity/cancellation guard through photo preparation and candidate traversal, checking it after awaits and before new work. Resume incomplete preparation when visible again rather than treating a paused page as successfully prepared. Existing network calls can finish, but hidden views should not start further fallback or batch work.
findings.limits: This reproduces unnecessary hidden work, not a proven permanent memory leak. Fully removed contexts already stop starting new work.

findings.title: Immediate URL rejection can be downloaded twice by painting and preparation before the shared renewal takes effect
findings.cause: prepareImage evicts a failed image stream while visible photos still hold the rejected URL in their own resolved future; their renewal is scheduled for a later frame. Re-resolving that evicted provider can start another rejected download before either consumer switches to the shared fresh URL. URL signing is shared, but the rejected download generation is not.

tests: review: immediate stale failures share a renewed download across paint and preparation
review: real cache-manager transport must not download the rejected URL twice
proof.transport: Installed flutter_cache_manager CacheManager + HttpFileService + MockClient returning HTTP 403 for the rejected URL

findings.recommendation: Publish/share failed URL generations before evicting their image keys, and let painting/preparation join or follow the same recovery operation. Consumers that still hold an obsolete future should switch to the shared renewal instead of decoding/downloading its rejected provider again. Preserve the existing decode bounds and do not coalesce distinct image sizes by retaining full-resolution originals.

verified_without_new_findings: Existing 201 related tests pass, covering home/collection, reader turns and rotation, URL refresh and cache bounds, disposal, preview/original fallback, template rendering and print/crop requirements
Three repeated cover-to-collection-to-reader visits with four rapid rotations per reader entry restore photos on return without layout exceptions
The tested repeated navigation releases every tracked ui.Image handle after unmount and explicit cache clearing, with zero live/pending image-cache entries and zero transient callbacks

Four reader entries closed during a gated cover download and intervening rotations do not start inner-page/original fallback work after all contexts are removed; late failure causes no unhandled exception
The original reader-entry AnimatedSize layout exception does not recur in the tested cases
Shared storage URL signing and the successful renewed download remain deduplicated in the immediate-failure reproduction

fresh_review_cases.failure_note: Four regression tests intentionally assert the desired behavior and remain failing on the three unfixed production findings; two tests independently confirm the rejected-download duplication at different seams

verification.format: New review test formatted; scoped diff whitespace check clean

limits: Review only: no production fixes are included. Network failures, byte delivery and signing are controlled fixtures with real Flutter image decoding. The transport confirmation runs the installed cache-manager implementation with a mock HTTP client, not a live storage service. Widget/cache/handle assertions do not measure whole-device memory or frame time and cannot prove the absence of every native leak or frame drop.
